title: Phase-zero testkit decomposition
description: Objective: split oversized Phase-zero evidence capture and verifier modules by I/O port, canonicalization, and verification responsibility. Deliverable: smaller testkit production modules with identical evidence hashes and verdicts. NOT in scope: changing pinned evidence contracts or confirmatory benchmark data. Hard dependencies: none. Owned paths: packages/testkit/src/phase0-evidence-capture.ts, packages/testkit/src/phase0-evidence-manifest-verifier.ts, new phase0-*.ts internals, and their focused tests. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/testkit typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/testkit test.
definitionOfDone: Existing fixture hashes, PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN verdicts, and stable errors remain unchanged.
No confirmatory BENCH corpus bytes are introduced.
Every resulting production module is under 350 lines.
The focused testkit typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only tasks preserve public contracts and stable errors.
Do not weaken or rewrite tests to make the split pass.
Stage only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, or merge.

Build a compact synthetic manifest/object reader without confirmatory BENCH corpus data and pin the exact manifest identity/hash and canonical manifestJson, status-first then PHASE0_ROLE_METADATA read order, exact Error code/detail precedence for read/location/content failures, frozen result/nested values, and defensive readEvidence copies. Exercise only the existing public facade so the test remains valid after decomposition; keep this new test <=250 physical lines and do not edit or weaken the existing hostile, composition, boundary, or correction suites.
implementationPlan.note: Added packages/testkit/src/phase0-evidence-manifest-verifier.test.ts (244 physical lines, 28 tests, all green against the pre-refactor code). Compact synthetic fixture only - six one-line role documents plus a synthetic porcelain status blob, no BENCH corpus bytes. Pins: exact canonical manifestJson and manifest identity, status-object-first then PHASE0_ROLE_METADATA read order, frozen result/identity/manifest/entries/sourceState/observations, defensive readEvidence copies plus unknown-role error, 17 structural decode error codes/details in first-failure order, and 5 reader failure paths incl. read -> location -> bounded/identity precedence and line-count-before-git-blob precedence. Exercises only the public facade (verifyPhase0EvidenceManifest), so it stays valid after decomposition. Existing hostile/composition/freeze suites untouched. Verified: pnpm --filter @moe/testkit typecheck clean; vitest on the new file 28/28 pass.

implementationPlan.description: Extract the capture port contract and hostile I/O boundary into phase0-evidence-capture-port.ts with its one-line .js bridge. Move the seven public raw/receipt/port interfaces plus source-path receipt validation, repository snapshot/status validation, commit-bound path lookup, object write/read receipt validation, and final stored-object reread helpers without changing call order or errors. Keep OS-independent Windows path comparison via win32 semantics; propagate source/snapshot/lookup exceptions exactly as today and retain only the existing object-store normalization. In phase0-evidence-capture.ts, type-re-export every public interface under its current name so index.ts, phase0-node-capture-port.ts, phase0-node-git.ts, and external package consumers require no edits.
implementationPlan.note: DEVIATION (recorded per convention-contracts-250-line-splits): the single planned phase0-evidence-capture-port.ts would have been ~340 physical lines, over the epic <=250 rail, so the boundary was split along its real seams into three modules, each with its one-line .js bridge: phase0-evidence-capture-port.ts (81) holds the seven public port/receipt interfaces plus the stable captureError text factory and equalBytes; phase0-evidence-source-reader.ts (175) holds source-file receipt validation, repository snapshot/status validation, and commit-bound path lookup incl. win32 path comparison and sha1/sha256 OID framing; phase0-evidence-object-store.ts (111) holds object write/read receipt validation, persist-and-verify, and the final stored-object reread set. Bodies moved verbatim - same call order, same first-failure precedence, same error codes/details, same defensive slices, only the object-store failures stay normalized. phase0-evidence-capture.ts type-re-exports all seven interfaces under their current names, so index.ts, phase0-node-capture-port.ts, phase0-node-git.ts, and the existing suites needed no edits. Verified: pnpm --filter @moe/testkit typecheck clean; pnpm --filter @moe/testkit test 14 files / 192 tests pass.
